Commentary.Commentary: Right then! Tamim Iqbal collects the trophy and he joins his teammates for a photograph. All smiles in the Bangladesh camp! That's it from the coverage of this game and also this series. West Indies now will turn their heads to their series against the traveling Indian side. It will begin on 22nd July 2022 at 7.00 pm IST (1:30 pm GMT), while Bangladesh will travel to Zimbabwe for their next assignment which will begin on 30th July, 2022 at 3.30 pm IST (10.00 am GMT). You can also join us early for the build-ups. Until then take care and goodbye.

Tamim Iqbal the captain of Bangladesh is the Player of the Series! He says that they have always been a good side at home, but to get a series win away from home feels good. Adds that the conditons were not easy but they performed well. Mentions that they are missing out on some major players, but the other players really stepped up. Ends by praising Nurul Hasan and Nasum Ahmed for their performances throughout the series, and he is happy that Taijul Islam's stepped up when he was given the opportunity.

Nicholas Pooran the skipper of West Indies says they spoke about taking the game deep which they did, he felt like today was his day to score but he fell short of a few runs and it was disappointing. Mentions that it was difficult to bat but he felt he had to just be there, he does not stress on batting too much, he is confident about his batting unit, but it has been frustrating for the batting unit, but they will learn from this and get better.

Taijul Islam is the Player of the Match! He says that he is very fortunate to get an opportunity, he has been working hard and he is really happy he grabbed his opportunity. Mentions that he had no additional pressure, he just stuck to his plans and bowled in the right areas.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the innings, Bangladesh bowlers justified their skipper's decision of bowling first by taking three early wickets. They executed their plans really well and kept things tight throughout. Taijul Islam ended with a five-wicket haul. Nicholas Pooran was the only batter who stood out for the hosts. During the chase, Bangladesh were put under pressure in patches but they managed to get over the line to end the series on a high.

The hosts put up a solid fight but it wasn't enough against this experienced lot of Bangladesh batters. They only were able to take a single wicket inside the first Powerplay. Although, it was Gudakesh Motie who impressed with his four-fer in an economical spell. He dominated the proceedings in the middle overs and kept his side in the hunt. In the slog overs, West Indies bowlers were unable to keep things tight and eventually failed to get over the line.

The visitors started cautiously with Tamim Iqbal dominating the opening play, although Najmul Hossain Shanto never looked settled and departed early on. The skipper continued the good work with Litton Das on the other end. The latter racked up his half-century as well to ease down some pressure off his team. Several batters contributed to the victory, it was Mahmudullah who played a vital knock to get his side closer to the victory line. In the end, Mehidy Hasan and Nurul Hasan applied the finishing touches with their unbeaten stand of 32 runs.

Bangladesh extends their winning streak against West Indies in ODIs to 11 wins on the trot. They have also completed a clean sweep over West Indies in this ODI series. West Indies were bowled out in every single match in this series and they would be very disappointed about the same.
Shorter ball, outside off. Mehidy Hasan stays in his crease and cuts it towards point for a single. Bangladesh win by 4 wickets!
Loopy ball, very full, around off. Nurul Hasan drives it past the bowler, down to long off for a single. Scores are level!
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Mehidy Hasan knocks it down to long on for a single. 2 required now!
Fuller ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan drives and finds the fielder at mid off. Bangladesh need just 3 runs more!
Pitches it up, outside off. Nurul Hasan presses forward and taps it towards cover-point.
Good-length delivery, outside the off pole. Mehidy Hasan drives it past backward point. Only a single.
Angling in, on the pads, pitched up as well. Nurul Hasan flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Full in length, outside off. Mehidy Hasan drives wide of mid off for a quick single.
On a length, outside off. Mehidy Hasan stays in his crease and dabs it towards point.
Wide! Down the leg side fuller ball. Mehidy Hasan misses his flick and a wide is called!
Tosses it up, a low full toss, around middle. Mehidy Hasan pushes it towards long on for a single.
Another shorter ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan knocks it off the back foot through cover for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Nurul Hasan hangs back and pushes it towards cover for a brace.
Tosses this one up, full and outside off. Nurul Hasan drives and finds the fielder at cover.
On the pads now, shortish ball. Mehidy Hasan shuffles across and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
A shorter ball, spinning in, around middle and off. Mehidy Hasan pushes it towards cover. A dot to begin with!
Nicholas Pooran comes back into the attack.
Fuller ball, wide of off. Nurul Hasan opens the face of the bat and drives it towards the fielder at point. 12 needed off 24 balls.
Alzarri Joseph drops it short now, outside off, at 126 clicks. Nurul Hasan lets that go through.
Very full, around off. Nurul Hasan pushes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Alzarri Joseph errs in line now, he serves it down the leg side, a low full toss as well. Nurul Hasan looks to flick this one, but he misses.
Width on offer now, on a length. Mehidy Hasan opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a run.
Back of a length, outside off. Nurul Hasan cuts it square off the wicket on the off side. A single taken!
On a length, outside off. Nurul Hasan stays in his crease and tries to cut this away, but the ball goes off his bottom edge onto the deck.
Full, tosses it up, outside off. Mehidy Hasan leaves it alone. Another maiden over from Akeal Hosein!
Shorter one, spinning away, around off. Mehidy Hasan pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Quicker, fuller, outside off. Mehidy Hasan is happy to let that go.
Outside off, tad shorter. Mehidy Hasan cuts it towards point.
Another loopy ball, on middle, full in length. Mehidy Hasan leans forward and blocks it out.
Outside off, fuller one, spinning away. Mehidy Hasan leaves it alone.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A shorter ball, spinning in, around middle. Nurul Hasan uses the depth of his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tosses it up, full in length, around middle and off. Nurul Hasan blocks it out.
Pitches it up, around middle and leg. Mehidy Hasan gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards fine leg. Single taken!
A low full toss, outside off. Nurul Hasan steps down the pitch and strokes it down to long off for a run.
Full and on middle. Mehidy Hasan leans forward and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Shorter one, turning in, around middle and leg. Nurul Hasan hangs back and pushes it towards square leg for a single.
Full, around off, tosses it up. Mehidy Hasan lunges forward and blocks it out. Back-to-back maidens over from Akeal Hosein! Bangladesh need 23 more off 42 balls.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Mehidy Hasan leans forward and defends it out solidly.
Lovely delivery! A fuller one, it lands around off and spins away. Mehidy Hasan presses forward and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Pitches it up again, on the pads. Mehidy Hasan flicks it towards square leg. He wanted to single there, but Mehidy Hasan is sent back!
Full again, tosses it up around middle and leg. Mehidy Hasan lunges forward and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Full, quick and on middle. Mehidy Hasan leans forward and blocks it out.
Change of pace now! A slower yorker, around the off pole. Nurul Hasan digs it out towards the fielder at cover. Bangladesh need 23 more off 48 balls with 4 wickets in hand.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg, at 145 clicks. Mehidy Hasan tucks it towards square leg and rotates the strike!
Good ball! A length delivery, around off, at 141 clicks. Nurul Hasan stays in his crease and tries to block this but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single.
Fraction shorter, around middle and off. Nurul Hasan pulls it gently towards mid-wicket. Three dots on the trot in this over!
Fuller one now, around middle and off. Nurul Hasan presses forward and defends it out.
On a length, outside off. Nurul Hasan hangs back and tries to cut this away but he misses.
Quicker, short and on middle. Mehidy Hasan defends it out. Bangladesh need 25 runs more!
Another shorter ball, outside off, Mehidy Hasan dabs it towards point.
Short ball, spinning away, outside off. Mehidy Hasan manages to get a slight outside edge away from the fielder at point.
Shorter one, quicker as well, around middle. Mehidy Hasan defends it back to the bowler.
Around middle and off, fuller one. Mehidy Hasan leans and blocks it out.
Well bowled! A fuller one, it lands around off and spins away. Mehidy Hasan gets beaten on the outside edge while trying to block that one.
Full and on middle. Mehidy Hasan leans and flicks it towards dee mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off. Mehidy Hasan drives it towards cover.
Shorter ball, around middle. Mehidy Hasan pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Romario Shepherd there slips and misfields. The batters grab two runs easily.
A low full toss, outside off. Nurul Hasan drives it towards cover and takes a single.
Fuller, on the pads. Mehidy Hasan knocks it down to long on for a single.
Shorter one, outside off. Mehidy Hasan pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a brace. He gets off the mark straightaway!
Mehidy Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Nicholas Pooran gets the breakthrough for his side. He finally gets rid of Mahmudullah! Another wicket at a good time for West Indies! A shorter ball, down the leg side. Mahmudullah advances down the pitch and tries to flick this one but he misses it completely. Shai Hope grabs the ball and whips the bails off. The replay shows that Mahmudullah is well out of his crease. He has to depart! A slight ray of hope for West Indies!
Commentary.Howout: st Shai Hope b Nicholas Pooran

Commentary.Commentary: Is that out? The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show there is no bat involved. The side-on shows that the batter is well short and the final decision is OUT.
It is tossed up, outside off, Mahmudullah works it to short third man for a single.
Full and on leg, Hasan tucks it to the leg side for one more.
Outside off, Mahmudullah guides it down to third man for one run.
A single as this is worked down to mid on.
Around off, defended out watchfully.
On the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it through square leg for one.
On off, Mahmudullah pushes it through covers for one.
Full length, outside off. Mahmudullah gets down the track and drives it along the ground for a brace.
Full and on leg. Mahmudullah comes down the track and pads it out.
Full and outside off. Nurul Hasan drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
On off, blocked out.
It is full, going away with the arm. Mahmudullah gets his blade down in time. It goes towards short third man for one.
Nicholas Pooran brings himself back into the attack.
Flatter, outside off. Hasan taps it to point. A dot to end the over.
FOUR! Short and punished. Back of a length, on middle. Nurul Hasan stays back and pulls it over mid-wicket. It goes into the boundary.
Full length, on middle and leg. Nurul Hasan comes down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and short, outside off, Mahmudullah pushes it to covers for one.
On middle and leg, Mahmudullah flicks it to mid-wicket.
Darts on the pads, Mahmudullah clips to mid-wicket.
FOUR! A great over for Bangladesh. Nurul Hasan ends the over on a high. Fraction short, outside off. Nurul Hasan stays back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Short ball, on the body. Mahmudullah swivels on the back foot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Low full toss, on middle and leg. Nurul Hasan flicks it to deep square leg for one more.
Back of a length, outside off. Mahmudullah guides it through back point for a single.
Good length, outside off. Mahmudullah dabs it down to point. Two dots to start with.
Length ball, angled down leg, Mahmudullah fails to clip it away. It brushes his pads and goes into the keeper's mitts.
FOUR! Nicely played. A short ball, on off. Nurul Hasan stays back and pulls it through the gap at mid-wicket for a fine boundary.
On off, pushed to covers.
On the stumps. Mahmudullah goes back and punches it to point for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Mahmudullah blocks it off his front foot.
Fuller, drifting down leg. Mahmudullah clips it to fine leg.
Full, on leg. Hasan makes room and pushes it through point for a single.

DRINKS! Bangladesh are still on top of proceedings here! They need 61 more runs with 5 wickets in hand and plenty of overs to go. The hosts do remain the favorites to win this game, but West Indies have done well. They have grabbed wickets at crucial junctures, but they need to grab quick wickets from here if they want to put further pressure on Bangladesh. It's not yet over for West Indies! Also, Akeal Hosein comes back to bowl.
Good length, outside off, left alone by Mahmudullah. Just two runs off it. West Indies not allowing the batters to breathe freely here.
Length, on off, defended out solidly.

A loud appeal for lbw but the umpire shows no interest. This one stays low off the deck which catches Nurul Hasan off guard. It is a length ball, on off. This one stays low off the deck. Nicholas Pooran takes the review. The UltraEdge shows there is a spike as the ball passes the blade. They lose a review. Bangladesh get a single in the end.
Full length, angled down leg. Hasan stays back and flicks it to deep square leg. He does not rotate the strike.
Full length, on the pads, Mahmudullah flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full length, outside off. Mahmudullah hangs his blade away from his body but gets no connection.
Alzarri Joseph (7-0-18-1) comes back to the bowl.
On off, defended out, solidly. Gudakesh Motie ends his spell of 10 overs with four wickets under his belly.
Nurul Hasan comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gudakesh Motie grabs his fourth wicket. He is bringing his side back in the mix here. It tossed up, around off. Mosaddek Hossain dances down the track and lofts it towards long on. Jayden Seales, the substitute fielder, runs in front of him, he fumbles initially but in the end pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Jayden Seales b Gudakesh Motie

Commentary.Commentary: A single now as this is pushed through covers.
Slower one, on leg, Mahmudullah blocks it out.
Around off, blocks it out solidly.
Short ball, outside off. Mahmudullah pushes it to mid off.
On middle and leg, clipped to square leg.
Looped up, on off, defended out.
SIX! Mosaddek Hossain stepping on the gas here. It is short and on off. Mosaddek Hossain pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
On leg, Hossain clips it to square on the leg side.
Short ball, outside off. Mahmudullah cuts it to point for a single.
On off, defended out.
FOUR! Up and over. It is full and on off. Mosaddek Hossain clears his front leg and tonks it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
A loud appeal for lbw but turned down. It is full, around middle and leg. Hossain fails to clip it away and gets rapped on the pads. Going down leg.
Tossed up, on off. Mosaddek Hossain goes back and eases it back to the bowler.
Floated and full, on off. Mosaddek Hossain gets it to square leg off the inner half.
Short ball, outside off. Mahmudullah cuts it through point on the back foot and collects a single.
Short and outside off, turning away. Mahmudullah blocks it out to point.
Around middle and leg, short in length. Mosaddek Hossain blocks it out off the back foot. Two runs off Nicholas Pooran's first over!
Quicker, around middle, shorter ball. Mosaddek Hossain tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter one, down the leg side. Mosaddek Hossain hangs back and flicks it towards square leg.
Flighted delivery, outside off this time. Mahmudullah steps down the pitch and drives it towards cover for a single.
Tosses it up, full and on the pads. Mahmudullah tucks it to the fielder at square leg.
Nicholas Pooran begins with a fuller ball, a loopy one, around middle. Mosaddek Hossain drives it towards long on for a single.
Nicholas Pooran gets himself into the attack now.
Floats this one up, full and around middle. Mahmudullah defends it out solidly. A maiden over from Gudakesh Motie!
On the pads now, fuller ball. Mahmudullah tucks it towards square leg.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Mahmudullah blocks it out.
Spinning away, shorter one, outside off. Mahmudullah pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mahmudullah gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this away but he misses as the ball spins away.
Quicker, at 90 clicks, fuller one, outside off. Mahmudullah uses the depth of his crease and taps it towards point.
Outside off, a length delivery. Mosaddek Hossain pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Another length ball, angling down leg. Mosaddek Hossain looks to flick this but he misses and the ball brushes off his thigh pads and goes towards the keeper.
On a length, outside off, Mosaddek Hossain covers the line of the ball and blocks it out.
Another length delivery, around the middle pole. Mosaddek Hossain walks across and tucks it through square leg for a brace. That brings up the 100 for Bangladesh! They are just 79 runs away now.
On a length, around off. Mosaddek Hossain shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Mosaddek Hossain walks across and pushes it towards mid on.
Tosses this one up, full and on the pads. Mahmudullah tucks it towards square leg.
Overpitches this one, on middle. Mosaddek Hossain clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up, full and on the pads. Mosaddek Hossain looks to flick this one but he gets a leading edge. The ball lobs up and falls short of the fielder at point.
Shorter one, outside off, it stays low as well. Mahmudullah hangs back and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Another loopy ball, full again, on middle. Mahmudullah blocks this one.
Fuller one, on middle. Mahmudullah presses forward and defends it out.
On a length, around middle and leg. Mosaddek Hossain blocks it out.
A stifled appeal there for LBW, but the umpire says no! On a length, angling in, down leg. Mosaddek Hossain looks to flick this one but he misses.
Back of a length, around middle and off, at 136 clicks. Mosaddek Hossain blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Alzarri Joseph pitches it up, outside off. Mahmudullah drives it past point for a single.
Outside off, fuller in length, at 134 clicks. Mahmudullah leans forward and defends it out.
Angling in, on a length, down the leg side. Mahmudullah looks to flick this one but he misses and gets hit hit on his pads.
Outside off, left alone. Two-wicket maiden for Gudakesh Motie. West Indies still have an outside chance to make a comeback.
Mosaddek Hossain comes to the crease.
OUT! TIMBER! Gudakesh Motie is doing the trick here for the hosts. It is full and on off. Afif Hossain comes down the track but misses it completely. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps.
Floated and full, on leg. Afif Hossain flicks it to fine leg. No run taken though.
Afif Hossain makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Gudakesh Motie gets his second wicket and sends back the man in form, Litton Das.  It is tossed up, on off. Litton Das pushes it to the right of the bowler but in the air. Gudakesh Motie reacts well and dives to his right to take a sharp catch.
Outside off, Das blocks it out to point.
Full, on middle and leg. Litton Das blocks it to the leg side.
Length ball, on off, flicked to mid on. A dot to end the over.
A yorker now, on middle and leg. Mahmudullah stays inside the crease and dabs it back to the bowler.
Full length, outside off. Mahmudullah plays it late and guides it down to third man. Anderson Phillip does well in the deep to keep the ball in play. They take two.
On off, blocked out.
FIFTY FOR DAS! He has been in incredible form in this series. It is a short ball, outside off. Litton Das cuts it to point for one. Das will be hoping to convert it to three figures.
FOUR! Exceptional shot. Fraction short, on off. Litton Das hits it down the ground. It goes into the fence at long on.
On off, blocked back to the bowler. Just a single off the over. Gudakesh Motie continues to keeps things tight in his spell.
Too full, on middle and leg. Mahmudullah stays inside his crease, luckily he was able to get his blade down in time.
Outside off. Das punches it through covers for a single.
Flatter and on off. Das fends it to point.
Full and outside off. Das blocks it to covers but not in the gap.
Loopy ball, full and on off. Das smothers it to point.
Full length, angled down leg. Litton Das flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full length, on middle and leg. Litton Das flicks it to the leg side but not in the gap.
Full length, outside off. Litton Das slashes it to point but straight to the fielder.
On a length, wide outside off. Mahmudullah blocks it out to point for a single.
Length, on off, defended out.
FOUR! Mahmudullah gets a bit fortunate this time. It is on a length, wide outside off. Mahmudullah looks to cut it away. It runs awyay to the third man fence off the inner half.
A great delivery to end the over! It is tossed up, just outside off. Litton Das stays back and tries to defend it out but misses. 6 runs off the over.
On middle and leg, Mahmudullah clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, around middle. This one grips off the deck. Mahmudullah tries to defend on his front foot but gets beaten.
It is tossed up, on off. Mahmudullah taps it to point.
Flighted and full, on off. Das drives it areially over covers and gets a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! It does not look good for Akeal Hosein. Full and outside off. Litton Das guides it down to third man. Akeal Hosein gives it a chase but it unable to keep it in play.
Pitches it up again, outside off. Litton Das drives it firmly towards deep cover for a single.
Swing and a miss! This one is angling in, outside off, fuller ball. Litton Das leans to drive but he misses.
Pulls his length further back, around off. Litton Das hops and taps it towards point.
On a length, around off, at 133 clicks. Litton Das blocks it out towards cover.
Pitches it up again, around off. Litton Das leans forward and pushes it towards mid on.
Romario Shepherd begins his second spell with a fullish delivery, around middle and leg. Litton Das tucks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, full and around middle. Litton Das lunges forward and gently tucks it towards long on for a single.
Pitches it up again, around off. Litton Das once again is solid in his front-foot defense.
Outside off, tosses it up, full. Litton Das prods forward and defends it out.
Another loopy ball, full on middle. Litton Das pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower through the air, tosses it up, around middle and leg. Litton Das clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller ball, loopy one, on middle. Litton Das leans forward and blocks it out.
Another length delivery, around off, at 141 clicks. Mahmudullah defends it out off the back foot. Only a run off the over!
Good-length delivery, at 141 clicks, outside off. Mahmudullah taps it towards point.
On a length, angling in, around middle and off, at around 136 clicks. Mahmudullah blocks it out.
Very full this time, swinging in, on middle. Mahmudullah pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off this time, a length delivery, at 139 clicks. Mahmudullah leaves it alone.
Alzarri Joseph begins his second spell with a length ball, angling in on the pads. Litton Das tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Change. Alzarri Joseph is brought back into the attack.
Pitches it up again, around middle, slower one. Litton Das knocks it down to long on for a single. He retains the strike!
Full and spinning away, around middle and off. Litton Das lunges forward and defends it out.

DRINKS! Bangladesh have their noses in front, although anything can happen in cricket and West Indies will truly hope to build on this wicket of the Bangladeshi skipper. The bowlers though don't have a huge target to defend and they need to keep things tight with their spinners operating in tandem. Nonetheless, it won't be easy against a talented batting pack of Bangladesh. Mahmudullah is out on the field now to make his presence felt. Can he take his side closer to the finish line?

OUT! TAKEN! Tamim Iqbal goes for the sweep again but he holes out this time. Gudakesh Motie gets rid of the Bangladesh skipper now. A fuller ball, spinning down leg, slower as well. Tamim Iqbal gets down on his knee and tries to slog-sweep this again. Only this time the ball goes off his top edge towards fine leg. Akeal Hosein runs forward, settles under it, and takes a good catch. Bangladesh lose their second wicket. They need 109 more to win.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Gudakesh Motie

Commentary.Commentary: Very full, around middle. Litton Das knocks it down to long on for a run.
Slower through the air, full and around off. Tamim Iqbal gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards fine leg for a run.
Full in length, around off, spinning away a tad. Litton Das chips it uppishly well shot of long off. Only a single.
Back to over the wicket, a fuller one, on the pads. Litton Das tucks it towards square leg and retains the strike with a single.
Goes over the wicket now, serves a fuller one, around off. Tamim Iqbal sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around middle and off. Litton Das punches it off the back foot towards long on for a single.

A fuller ball, outside off. Litton Das gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this but he misses and gets hit on back pad. An appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger! Litton Das opts for a review. Nothing on UltraEdge and Ball Tracking indicates the impact was outside. Litton Das survives! A successful review.
Short again, this, one keeps low, on middle. Litton Das does to get his bat down in time to block this one.
FOUR! Nicely done! A shorter one, outside off. Litton Das uses the depth of his crease and slashes it towards third man for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Tamim Iqbal fends it out to safety.
It is full and on off. Iqbal stays back to block it out. This has been a good performance from West Indies so far with the ball.
Looped up, around off, Iqbal remains solid in his defense.
Full, on off. Iqbal gets on the front foot to block it out.
A single now as this is worked to square leg.
Full and on off, Das defends it out watchfully.
Gudakesh Motie is introduced into the attack.
Full length, on off. Iqbal defends it out solidly.
Full length, on middle and leg. Das clips it through square leg for one.
On off, pushed out to safety.
It is full and on off. Tamim Iqbal reverse-sweeps it down to third man for a single.
Full, on off, blocked out.
FOUR! Tickled away! It is full, angled down leg. Tamim Iqbal stays back and glances it down to fine leg. The outfield is quick and the balls races away to the boundary.
Full length, wide outside off. Iqbal reaches out and slashes it to point for a single. 7 runs off the over. Bangladesh are on the driving seat here.
Slight halt in play! Rovman Powell seems to be in pain. He is seen holding the right side of his stomach and the physio is out there. He walks off the field. Keacy Carty will complete his over.

FOUR! A loosener now and Iqbal wastes no time to make the most of it. It is full, angled down leg. Tamim Iqbal flicks it through square leg for four. Rovman Powell is down with pain. Looks like he did not land well.
Full length, on middle. Tamim Iqbal works it to the leg side with a closed face of the blade.
Touch fuller, on off. Iqbal defends it to point.
Length ball, on off. Das punches it through covers for one.
Full length, on off. Iqbal works it to third man for a single.
Deft touch! It is on a length, around off. Litton Das guides it down to third man for a brace.
It is full and on off. Das defends it out solidly.
FOUR! This is a man in form! Back of a length, outside off, Litton Das stays back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
On a length, on off. Litton Das defends it out.
SIX! Litton Das with beautiful piece of timing. It is full and on leg. Litton Das comes down the track, uses his wrists really well and sends the ball sailing over the long on fence.
It is looped up, around middle, turning away late. Litton Das waits for it and dabs it to backward point.
Length and on the pads, Litton Das clips it to square leg for one.
Full and on middle, Das flicks it to the leg side.
It is angled into the pads, on a fuller length. Das stays back and eases it to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Iqbal steps across and defends it to point for a quick single. This is really good running.
Full and on middle. Tamim Iqbal gets across the line and tucks it to mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
It is a short ball, outside off. Tamim Iqbal cuts it to the off side.
Tosses it up, full and around middle and off. Tamim Iqbal pushes it towards long on for a single. That will be the end of the first Powerplay!
Back of a length now, around middle. Litton Das pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, full in length. Tamim Iqbal works it down to long on for a single.

An appeal for an LBW, but the umpire says no! Akeal Hosein goes 'over the wicket, serves a fuller ball, spinning down leg. Tamim Iqbal leans forward to block this but he misses and gets hit on his pads. The impact was probably outside.
Fuller one now, on the pads. Litton Das prods forward and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Akeal Hosein begins with a shorter ball, spinning away, around middle and off. Litton Das hangs back and cuts it towards cover-point.
Full now, on the pads. Tamim Iqbal flicks it but finds the fielder at square leg.
Angling in a length delivery, on the pads. Litton Das tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Another length ball, outside off, keeps low as well, at 141 clicks. Litton Das gets his bat down in time and defends it out.
On a length, outside off, at 139 clicks. Litton Das blocks it out.
Tad slower this time, at 127 clicks, full again, outside off. Litton Das presses forward and taps it towards cover.
Fuller one, on middle, at 139 clicks. Litton Das defends it out solidly.
Another length delivery, outside off. Litton Das steers it down to third man for a single. He retains the strike!
On a length outside off. Litton Das dabs it towards backward point off the back foot.
Angling in on a length, and on the pads. Tamim Iqbal flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Outside off, a length ball. Tamim Iqbal taps it towards point.
Oh, good delivery! A length ball, outside off, it keeps low as well. Tamim Iqbal stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he gets undone by the lack of bounce.
Good-length delivery, outside off, at 132 clicks. Tamim Iqbal prods forward and blocks it towards cover.
Wide! Romario Shepherd errs in line. He serves it down the leg side. Tamim Iqbal leaves it alone. Wide called!
Fuller now, outside off, at 139 clicks. Litton Das presses forward and defends it out. End of a successful over from Alzarri Joseph!
Angling in on a length, at 140 clicks, around middle. Litton Das shows the full face of the bat and defends it out.
A shorter one, around middle. Litton Das hangs back and blocks it out watchfully.
FOUR! Off with the mark with a boundary! A length ball, angling down the leg side. Litton Das flicks it fine, towards fine leg for a boundary.
Litton Das comes in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Alzarri Joseph strikes and picks up the first wicket for West Indies! Najmul Hossain Shanto's struggling innings comes to an end. A length ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto presses forward and tries to block this but the ball goes off his outside edge back to the keeper. Shai Hope pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Shai Hope b Alzarri Joseph

Commentary.Commentary: Angling in, on a length, around the pads. Tamim Iqbal flicks it through square leg for a single.
Outside off, on a length. Najmul Hossain Shanto defends it out.
Good-length delivery, around the pads. Tamim Iqbal clips it uppishly over mid-wicket. The ball will not race away but the batters pick up three runs.
Fuller now, outside off, at 137 clicks. Tamim Iqbal presses forward and blocks it out.
A stifled appeal for an LBW, but the umpire is unmoved! Another length delivery, angling in, on the pads. Tamim Iqbal misses his tuck and gets hit high on his thigh pad.
On a length, darting it on the thigh pads. Najmul Hossain Shanto tucks it towards square leg for a single. He finally gets off the mark with that!
A fuller ball, outside off, this one stays low. Najmul Hossain Shanto looks to heave this away but he gets undone by the lack of bounce.
FOUR! Incredible shot. This boundary ends the over on a high for Bangladesh. It is short and outside off. Tamim Iqbal cuts it through point for a boundary.
Full length, wide outside off. Tamim Iqbal drives it to covers with one hand, unable to find the gap.
Good length, on off. Tamim Iqbal gets a bit squared up this time. It goes to the off side off his outer half.
Length ball, on off, blocked off.
Full length, wide outside off. Tamim Iqbal expands his arms yet again and goes for the drive. It takes the inside edge but luckily it stops between his legs.
Full length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal tries to drive it through covers, although it rolls to mid on off the inner half.
WIDE! Full length, down leg. Tamim Iqbal fails to tickle it away. Wided. Great work by Shai Hope behind the sticks.

Use of the feet could've gotten him into trouble. It is a length ball, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to pressurize the bowler by stepping down the track but misses to work it away. It meets the keeper on a bounce.
Fraction short, outside off. Tamim Iqbal dabs it down to third man. Jayden Seales sprints to his left and saves a boundary with a dive. They take one.
Full length, on leg. Tamim Iqbal tries to go on side but it takes the leading edge, runs through the gap at covers. The batters take two runs.
Length ball, on the pads, Iqbal flicks it to mid-wicket.
Little bit of bounce this time. On a length, on off, this one flies off the deck. Tamim Iqbal says back and blocks it awkwardly to covers.
Length ball, on off. Tamim Iqbal presses forward and fends it out to mid on.
Swing and a miss! A length delivery, angled across the left-hander. Najmul Hossain Shanto tries to chase it but only connects with thin air.
Good length, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto blocks it out watchfully.
LEG BYE! Length ball, on the pads, Tamim Iqbal fails to tuck it away. It goes to the leg side off his pads. They collect a leg bye.
FOUR! Nicely played! Tamim Iqbal gets the first boundary of the chase. It is a short ball, outside off. Tamim Iqbal hangs back and cuts it powerfully through point for a boundary.
Full length, on off. Iqbal blocks it out solidly.
BEAUTY! A length ball, shaping away from around off. Tamim Iqbal keeps his hands low and lets the ball through.
Full length, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto stays back and blocks it to backward point.
On a length, around off, defended out.
Fraction short, outside off. Tamim Iqbal punches it to covers for one.
Full this time, on off. Iqbal smothers it to point. Three dots on the trot.
Iqbal walks across and flicks this full delivery to mid-wicket. The fielder there fumbles but the batters do not sneak in a single.
Touch fuller, outside off. Iqbal blocks it on his front foot.
Romario Shepherd will bowl from the other end.
Just a single off the over! A great start by Alzarri Joseph. This is shapes away from outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto keeps his blade to himself.
Length ball, around middle. Najmul Hossain Shanto stays back and defends it with full face of the blade.
Fuller, on off. Najmul Hossain Shanto pushes it to covers.
Fraction short, outside off. Najmul Hossain Shanto punches it to point on his back foot.
Tamim Iqbal and Bangladesh are off the mark! A length ball, around the hips. Tamim Iqbal flicks it to square leg for a single.
Alzarri Joseph starts right on the money. A length ball, on middle and leg, not giving much room. Iqbal blocks it with a full face.
